en.bilal-muhammad: Al-Husayn b. Ibrahim b. Natana (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Ibrahim narrated to us from his father from Muhammad b. Abi `Umayr from Hamza b. Humran. He said: Abu `Abdillah (as) said:

My grandson will be killed in Khurasan in a land called Tus. Whoever visits him, recognizing his right, he will take him by the hand on the Day of Resurrection and bring him into Paradise, even if he is from the people of major sins.

I said: May I be your ransom! What is recognition of his right? He said: To know that he is the Imam whose obedience is obligatory, and that he is a stranger and a martyr. Whoever visits him, recognizing his right, Allah will give him the reward of seventy martyrs who were martyred in front of the Messenger of Allah (s) in truth.
